notes_for_human: 1) PRIORITY FIELD FAILED CLEANLY: Amazon's cooling-off / online-assessment-retake rule could not be verified. Every candidate FAQ page on amazon.jobs renders question titles but hides answer bodies behind JavaScript accordions. A human with a browser should open https://amazon.jobs/content/en/faq/assessment and https://amazon.jobs/content/en/faq/application and expand each item. Do not backfill from Reddit/Blind/aggregators. 2) CONFLICT WORTH FLAGGING: Amazon's own program hub states internships are for 'rising seniors and recent graduates', while Amazon's newsroom (aboutamazon.com) has separately described internships as occurring between sophomore and junior years. I did not capture the newsroom sentence verbatim, so it is not recorded as a quote. These two tier-1 Amazon sources appear to disagree; a human should resolve before this row is published. 3) SOPHOMORE ANSWER: no Amazon program found that admits current college sophomores or first-years as an entry point. Amazon Future Engineer is the closest, but its entry gate is high school senior standing; the attached internship goes to scholarship winners, not to external sophomore applicants. No 'Propel' undergraduate program was found on any Amazon domain — searches returned nothing; treat as 'no evidence found', not 'does not exist'. 4) Job-posting rows are cycle-specific and will rot: job IDs 10435671 and 10418355 are live 2027-cycle reqs and will be delisted after the season. 5) Quotes were extracted via a page-summarizing fetch layer rather than direct DOM copy; the Accounting posting bullets and the AFE eligibility bullets read as clean verbatim, but a human should spot-check character-level fidelity before this goes into a citable public database.
